function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Conduct a comprehensive, source-bounded investigation of the Wirecard public-fraud trail. Focus specifically on: (1) Wirecard public company statements and disclosures, including what it asserted about its business, profits, cash, and third-party acquiring relationships; (2) audit uncertainty, auditor warnings, qualifications, withheld opinions, requests for evidence, and the timing and wording of relevant auditor communications; (3) the whereabouts and alleged absence of required cash, including trustee accounts, bank confirmations, escrow or trust arrangements, and what was verified versus alleged or inferred; (4) supervisory and regulatory failures involving Wirecard, its auditors, German and foreign regulators, parliamentary or official assessments, and any explicitly evidenced relationships or events; and (5) Jan Marsalek’s disappearance, including only tool-supported facts, allegations, sightings, official findings, and unresolved uncertainty. Return a structured evidence digest that uses source IDs exactly as returned by the benchmark tools. For every point, distinguish verified fact, allegation, assessment, inference, and unresolved uncertainty. Identify only entities, relationships, and events explicitly supported by the returned sources; do not fill gaps from general knowledge. Include a chronology where supported, explicit contradictions between sources or between public claims and later findings, and enough exact detail to support a final readable Markdown report containing findings, claims, reasoning steps, and contradictions. Do not invent source IDs or facts."}
function.name: ConductResearch
